audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault is absent from both layers, and it is the one ability in Pantheon's kit with a positional answer. Riot's text: he 'sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front'.
audit.why: Kassadin owns a 500-range blink. Getting behind a frontal invulnerability is the single highest-value thing Riftwalk does in this matchup, and on the worst-performing lane in the slice — 20% over 15 games — the page offers no way to beat the ability at all. It also runs 22/21/20/19/18s, which is the longest non-ultimate cooldown either champion has and therefore the real all-in window.
audit.corrected: Written into spikes[1].text, wants.you[2], whys[6], phases[4].why, phases[6].why, content.mid, content.late, winCon, tradeGood, breakdown.mid, breakdown.cooldowns, Key Ability Interactions and All-In Windows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mortal Will is described as blocking Kassadin's first auto every window, in wants.foe[2], content.early, content.mid and whys[2]. It does no such thing. Riot's text: 'Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.'
audit.why: The page attributes a damage-blocking effect to the passive, when the only thing in his kit that blocks damage is Aegis Assault — which the page never mentions. So the player is told to fear an interaction that does not exist and never told about the one that does. It also changes what to count: Mortal Will is a stack meter on his casts, not a shield on his person.
audit.corrected: Mortal Will described as a spell empowerment in all four places, and the blocking moved to Aegis Assault where it belongs.

audit.whatIsWrong: full.diff reads EVEN on a matchup recorded at 20% over 15 games, whose own diffRating is 8/10 and whose rating lines both say 'Hard matchup'.
audit.why: The lowest win rate in the slice labelled an even lane. Every other verdict field on the page already disagrees with it.
audit.corrected: diff set to HARD — four characters for four, so it fits the band exactly. diffRating and both rating lines already read 8/10 and 'Hard matchup' and were left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0] to [6] are the generic Kassadin boilerplate, and phases[6] promises 'the best scaling champion in the lobby' on a row the chart sides Pantheon — while content.late says Pantheon 'hard-falls-off' and whys[6] says Kassadin 'outscales him entirely'.
audit.why: Three fields describing the same stage, two of them agreeing with each other and the third contradicting both.
audit.corrected: phases[0], [2], [3], [4], [6] rewritten; win[6] and phases[6].side flipped from Pantheon to Kassadin, which fits the band because both words are eight characters.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d offers 'the fifteen-second invitation' after a spent Shield Vault, and breakdown.cooldowns prints no number for anything.
audit.why: Shield Vault is 13s at rank 1 and 9s at rank 5 — the fifteen is wrong at every rank and wrong by a third by the time it matters. Comet Spear is 11s to 8 and Aegis Assault 22s to 18, and the 22 is the number worth planning a commit around.
audit.corrected: All three written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, tradeGood, phases[3].why and All-In Windows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shield Vault's 600-unit dash is never stated — only that the stun is point-and-click.
audit.why: It is why 'stay at max Q range' does not work here the way it does against other melees: he closes 600 on his own and Null Sphere only reaches 650, so the safe distance is not the range of your own spell.

audit.whatIsWrong: Void Stone appears as '15% magic reduction' in spikes[3]; content.mid and spikes[2] claim Nether Blade's mana restore is 'quintupled'; phases[2].why carries the 'E only charges when spells fly' boilerplate; breakdown.late says 'Q-silence the counterplay'.
audit.why: Void Stone has been 10% since V11.24; Force Pulse stopped being charge-gated in V12.23 and is a 21/20/19/18/17s cooldown shortened by a second per nearby cast; Null Sphere has no silence; and no multiplier for Nether Blade appears in Riot's text.
audit.corrected: 15% set to 10%, the unsourced multiplier dropped, phases[2].why moved to the cooldown model, silence replaced with the shield.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are the worst part of my game against the worst possible enemy for it. Pantheon's W is a point-and-click stun he can't miss, and the instant it ends his empowered long-range Q spear chunks me while my Null Sphere shield is too small to matter and I have no Nether Blade mana yet to trade back. His Mortal Will passive blocks my first auto each window, so I lose every short exchange I start. I farm at the very edge of Q range, never walk into stun range to last-hit, and accept I am conceding this lane — dying here is how the 20% happens.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are the worst part of my game against the worst possible enemy for it. Shield Vault is a point-and-click stun and dash he can't miss, and the instant it ends his empowered Comet Spear chunks me while my Null Sphere shield is too small to matter and I have no Nether Blade mana to trade back. Mortal Will empowers his next spell every few casts, so his window always lands harder than mine. I farm at the very edge of Q range, never walk inside his stun, and accept I am conceding — dying here is how the 20% happens.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are still pure survival. A maxed Q and Nether Blade's quintupled mana-on-hit let me farm under tower without going broke, but I cannot fight a leveled Pantheon — his W-Q combo still out-damages my shield and his passive eats the first hit of every trade. Level 6 Riftwalk is my first breath: I use the blink to escape his all-in and dodge his ganks, not to fight. Watch for his global R when he recalls — he will roam off it, so ping mid/bot and play for my own farm, not for kills I can't get.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 are still pure survival. A maxed Q and Nether Blade's mana-on-hit let me farm under tower without going broke, but I cannot fight a leveled Pantheon — his W-Q combo out-damages my shield and Mortal Will keeps empowering the spell that starts it. Level 6 Riftwalk is my first breath, and it has one real use here: Aegis Assault is only invulnerable from the FRONT, so a blink behind it costs him twenty-two seconds for nothing. Otherwise use R to escape, and ping his global R roams.

notes: AEGIS ASSAULT IS THE FINDING HERE. This is the worst-performing matchup in the slice — 20% over 15 games — and neither layer mentioned the one ability Kassadin's kit is built to beat. Riot's text says Pantheon becomes 'invulnerable to damage from the front'; Kassadin has a 500-range blink and Aegis Assault is on 22/21/20/19/18s. Blinking behind it is the whole play and it was nowhere on the page. A SECOND, WEAKER INTERACTION I DELIBERATELY DID NOT WRITE: Aegis Assault is flagged as a channel in the kit, and Null Sphere interrupts channels per Riot's own description and the wiki. If Null Sphere cancels Aegis Assault outright that is bigger than the positional answer, but I could not confirm that Pantheon's E is interruptible by a damage-and-interrupt effect rather than only by hard CC, so it stays out of the page and goes in unverified. Worth a test in practice tool — it would be the highest-value line on this matchup. THIRD STALE/WRONG PASSIVE DESCRIPTION IN THIS SLICE: Mortal Will was described as blocking Kassadin's first auto each window in four strings. It empowers Pantheon's next spell. Combined with Mordekaiser's Q being called 'Mace of Spades' and Olaf's W being called 'Vicious Strikes', that is three matchups out of fourteen with a wrong passive or ability identity — a grep of champ-data for retired names looks worthwhile. CHART: win[6] and phases[6].side flipped Pantheon to Kassadin (both eight characters, so in band), matching content.late and whys[6] which both say he outscales Pantheon outright. Note the packet's levelChart records 'Skill' there rather than 'Kassadin'; if the packet is preferred, that cell needs a hand fix since 'Pantheon' to 'Skill' is out of band. win[4] reads Skill at level 6 while spikes[1] says level 6 only reaches 'barely survivable' and the packet says Pantheon — also out of band to correct. CHAMPION-WIDE: Void Stone is 10%, not 15% (V11.24); Force Pulse has not been charge-gated since V12.23 and the phases[2].why boilerplate is wrong on all 71 matchups.
